title: Ordinary Human Resume: preserve conflict status for changed start owners
outcome: Human-start owner/reset conflicts reach clients as typed 409 responses while persistence and unexpected failures remain 500.
acceptance: An owner/reset conflict in Human Send or Resume returns 409 without changing queue or runtime ownership; a persistence failure retains its internal-error response.
Focused route regressions cover the two response classes and the required review and gate evidence is recorded.
